research.qualityIntro: Evaluate materials using the documents for the actual product and batch. Availability of a report is shown explicitly; missing reports are not presented as verified results.
research.qualityIdentityBody: Check the chemical identity, composition, quantity and unit against the original specification. Analytical purity, material content and identity are different measurements.
research.qualityReportsBody: A report should identify the batch, laboratory, test method, result, unit and date. Accreditation or supplier quality claims are published only when their supporting evidence has been approved.
research.qualityHandlingBody: Use the conditions in the product-specific documentation. Do not assume that the same storage or preparation conditions apply to every material.
research.aboutIntro: AverianLabs brings product records, documentation and laboratory calculation tools together for research purchasing. Check each product’s current availability and published records before deciding whether it meets your requirements.
research.aboutEvidenceBody: Product information, batch reports and general guidance have different scopes. Open the original record to inspect its version, method and stated sample. Information that has not been confirmed stays marked as pending.
research.aboutSupportTitle: Get help with a specific requirement
research.aboutSupportBody: Include the product code (SKU), required quantity and the documents you need when contacting us. A quote request is separate from a direct order.
research.labIntro: Read the original report for the selected batch. The methods below describe different analytical questions and do not imply that every product has undergone every test.
research.labPurityBody: HPLC area purity describes the relative chromatographic peak areas under the reported method. It does not by itself establish the mass of peptide in a container; quantitative content requires an appropriate assay.
research.labIdentityBody: Mass spectrometry can provide molecular-mass evidence. A sequence or composition claim needs the appropriate supporting analysis and specification; mass alone is not a complete sequence determination.
research.labEndotoxinBody: Endotoxin, sterility and other test results are shown only when applicable and supported by the report. Retain the units used in the original result, such as EU/mg.
research.coaIntro: Find published documents for a product or batch. A document link is not a blanket PASS designation; assess the methods and results in the original report.

research.privacyIntro: This notice describes the storefront’s personal data processing. For questions about your information, contact the seller using the details below.
research.privacyDataBody: Accounts store your email, name and a password hash or a connected sign-in identity. Orders store contact details, addresses, purchased items and payment references. Quote requests and support messages store the details you submit. These records support purchasing, account access and customer service. You may explicitly save private calculations and community drafts to your account. Saving them does not publish them or send them to the AI provider. Submitted community posts are reviewed before publication, and the AI provider may assist moderation. Saved calculations and drafts can be deleted, are included in your account export, and are removed when your account is deleted.
research.privacyAnalyticsBody: Optional analytics load only after you accept them. You can withdraw consent using Cookie settings in the footer. Private account and checkout pages are excluded from analytics. If you use the assistant, your submitted messages are processed by the configured AI provider; saved conversation memory requires its separate consent setting.
research.privacyBasisBody: Order processing relies on performance of a contract and accounting records on applicable legal obligations. Optional analytics and saved assistant memory rely on consent. Security and support processing must be documented under the appropriate legal basis. Configured payment, email, hosting, storage and AI providers process the data needed to provide their services. The seller must make its approved provider list and transfer safeguards available before accepting orders.
research.privacyRightsBody: You may request access, correction, erasure, restriction or portability of your personal data and object where applicable. Account settings provide an export and deletion request. You may also contact Finland’s Office of the Data Protection Ombudsman (tietosuoja.fi). The EU General Data Protection Regulation and Finland’s Data Protection Act (1050/2018) apply.
research.privacyRetentionBody: Deleting an account disables access and removes sign-in credentials and private account content immediately. This cannot be undone. Purchase records and other records subject to legal retention are retained separately. The seller must approve and publish the retention periods for accounting, support, logs, backups and external providers before launch.
research.cookiesIntro: Essential browser storage supports sign-in, your cart, checkout progress, saved products and your consent choices. Optional analytics require your consent.
research.cookiesEssentialBody: The age confirmation and cookie choice are stored for up to one year. The sign-in session lasts up to 30 days. Cart, checkout progress, saved products and comparisons use browser local storage until you clear them. Payment providers may use storage required to process your payment.
research.cookiesAnalyticsBody: When configured, PostHog and Vercel Analytics or Speed Insights load after you accept optional analytics. PostHog session recording and automatic interaction capture are disabled. Analytics exclude private account and checkout routes, and page URLs omit query parameters.
research.cookiesChoiceBody: Use Cookie settings in the footer to reopen the choice. Selecting essential only stops optional analytics collection. You can also clear saved cart, checkout and consent information through your browser settings.
research.termsIntro: These purchasing terms describe the currently supported storefront. Obtain the seller’s registered details and approved commercial terms before placing an order.
research.termsUseBody: Materials are intended for laboratory research. They are not supplied for human or veterinary administration. Review the product-specific specification, handling information and original batch reports before deciding whether a material is suitable for your research.
research.termsPriceBody: Direct checkout currently supports delivery to Finland in euros. Displayed product and delivery prices include Finnish VAT at 25.5%. Checkout shows the final total before payment. Entering a VAT ID does not enable reverse charge or remove VAT. Other destinations and tax arrangements require a separate quote.
research.termsAvailabilityBody: Direct purchase requires an approved product specification, an assigned released batch, a published report and available stock. Stock is reserved temporarily during payment. An order is shown as paid only after the payment provider confirms it. A late payment that cannot be fulfilled automatically is held for review.
research.termsDeliveryBody: Available delivery methods, charges and estimates appear at checkout. Dispatch timing, handling conditions and return arrangements must be confirmed for the order. Contact support with the order number to report damage, an incorrect item or a return request. Statutory rights remain unaffected.
research.disclaimerIntro: Catalogue information supports the evaluation and purchase of laboratory materials.
research.disclaimerUseBody: The catalogue and concentration calculator do not provide medical advice, treatment recommendations or administration instructions. Product documentation does not establish suitability for human or veterinary use.
research.disclaimerEvidenceBody: Chromatographic purity, chemical identity and peptide content are different measurements. Assess the original test method, result, unit and batch ID. A document link does not mean that every test passed or that all materials were tested in the same way.
research.shippingIntro: Direct checkout currently supports Finland. Contact us for other destinations and purchasing arrangements.
research.shippingRatesBody: Checkout calculates delivery using the selected method. Delivery is free when the product subtotal is at least €150. Displayed delivery prices include VAT. Estimates depend on the carrier and destination.
research.shippingHandlingBody: Use the product-specific handling documents for storage requirements. Contact support if your work requires special transport conditions or a confirmed dispatch date.
research.shippingReturnsBody: Contact support with your order number before sending an item back. Include the item, batch and the reason for your request. Report damage or a mismatch with the order as soon as you can.

experience.processEyebrow: How a research task moves here
experience.processTitle: From material to documented decision in four steps.
experience.processLead: Every workflow follows the same evidence trail. Each step leaves a written record.
experience.processStep1Body: Search by name or SKU. The result lists identity, available sizes and document status.
experience.processStep2Body: Find the certificate, the batch report or the methodology page that matches your question.
experience.processStep3Body: Use the calculator for mass concentration, dilution and aliquot math, with explicit units.
experience.processStep4Body: Export the result, post a private draft, or contact us with the reference numbers.
experience.scenariosTitle: Calculations you can run with confidence
experience.scenariosLead: Common research tasks translated into formulas with units you can audit.
experience.scenario1Body: Divide the nominal mass by the final solution volume. Units stay with the value.
experience.scenario2Body: Use C₁V₁ = C₂V₂ to find the volume needed from a stock solution.
experience.scenario3Body: Total volume of the prepared solution — distinct from the solvent added.
experience.scenario4Body: How many equal portions a working volume will yield at your chosen sub-volume.
experience.methodsLead: Each analytical method answers a specific question. The right one depends on what you need to know.
experience.method1Body: A chromatographic measurement. Useful as a relative indicator when interpreted with the original report.
experience.method2Body: Detects gram-negative bacterial endotoxin in the sample. Expressed in EU per vial or per mg.
experience.method3Body: Confirms molecular weight and supports identity. Pairs with chromatographic data.
experience.glossaryLead: Research documents have specific vocabulary. Short definitions for the terms you will meet in certificates and reports.
experience.glossaryTerm1Def: Stock-keeping unit. The exact catalogue code that names a specific variant of a product.
experience.glossaryTerm2Def: The material produced in one manufacturing run. Each batch has its own certificate.
experience.glossaryTerm3Def: Certificate of Analysis. An original document reporting what was tested and the result.
experience.glossaryTerm4Def: Total solution volume after adding solvent. Distinct from the volume of solvent added.
experience.glossaryTerm5Def: A measured sub-volume taken from a larger solution.
experience.glossaryTerm6Def: Confirmation that the molecule in the vial matches the molecule named on the label.
experience.newsletterBody: Periodic notes on new batches, published certificates and methodology changes. No marketing.
experience.footerAboutBody: A catalogue and workflow workspace for laboratory research materials. Built around documented evidence.
experience.qualityHero: Evaluate a material from its actual documents.
experience.qualityBody: Every claim about a material or batch should be checked against its original record. This page explains how to read the different documents and where their evidence begins and ends.
experience.qualitySection1Lead: Begin with the product and variant, not the batch.
experience.qualitySection1Body: Confirm the chemical name, sequence or composition, quantity and unit on the product specification. Analytical purity, content by weight and identity are separate measurements.
experience.qualitySection2Lead: A report describes what was tested on one batch.
experience.qualitySection2Body: A complete report identifies the batch ID, the laboratory, the method used, the result and the unit. Published reports are linked from the product page.
experience.qualitySection3Title: Match the method to the question
experience.qualitySection3Body: HPLC area purity describes what was detected in the chromatogram. Endotoxin describes gram-negative contamination. Mass spectrometry confirms identity. Look at the method before reading the number.
experience.qualitySection4Lead: Use the conditions in the approved documentation.
experience.qualitySection4Body: Storage temperature, light sensitivity, reconstitution instructions and stability windows are product-specific. Do not assume common conditions apply to a new material.
experience.qualityFaq1Q: Is a published certificate a PASS designation?
experience.qualityFaq1A: No. A published certificate is the original record for what was tested on that batch. Read the method, the result and the unit; the report does not imply that the material is suitable for every research purpose.
experience.qualityFaq2Q: Why is a batch missing a certificate?
experience.qualityFaq2A: Some batches have not yet been released, or testing has not been completed. Missing reports are shown explicitly as missing — they are not presented as verified results.
experience.qualityFaq3Q: What is the difference between area purity and content?
experience.qualityFaq3A: HPLC area purity is a chromatographic measurement of detector response, not a measured mass fraction. Use the product specification for quantitative content; use area purity with its own caveat.
experience.qualityFaq4Q: Can I request a custom certificate format?
experience.qualityFaq4A: Contact us with the certificate number, your institution and the format you need. Custom reports follow the same review and approval path as published reports.
experience.aboutHero: A peptide shop for research, with every certificate in the open.
experience.aboutBody: AverianLabs supplies research peptides for laboratory use and publishes the documents that go with them. Every vial is linked to a production batch, every batch has a certificate, and every certificate is available to read before you order.
experience.aboutMissionBody: Buying a research peptide should not mean trusting a marketing page. We publish the batch, the certificate and the measured purity for the exact vial you receive, so you can check our claims instead of taking them on faith.
experience.aboutPrinciple1Body: Each product lists its current availability, the sizes we stock and the size of the batch behind it.
experience.aboutPrinciple2Body: Missing certificates are shown as missing. We never present an unverified result as a verified one.
experience.aboutPrinciple3Body: A product page tells you what the material is, what it is used for in the lab and how it is supplied. The specification, the batch certificate and the general method note answer different questions, and we keep them separate.
experience.aboutPrinciple4Body: Calculator inputs are labelled with origin. Units stay attached. Formulae are visible alongside results.
experience.aboutAudienceBody: Researchers, principal investigators, biotech teams and hospital pharmacies that need clear documentation alongside the materials they evaluate.
experience.aboutAudienceAudienceList: Research universities · Biotech R&D · Hospital pharmacies · Independent laboratories · Public research institutes

3.title: Check out in a minute

4.title: Track and read

faq.title: Questions people ask us
faq.subtitle: The questions we are asked most, answered plainly. Whatever is missing, ask the team.

1.question: What exactly do I receive?
1.answer: A lyophilised or solution-form research material in a labelled vial, in the size you selected. Every vial carries a batch code that maps to its certificate of analysis.

2.question: How do I know what is in the vial?
2.answer: The product page lists the molecule, its CAS number, molar mass and measured HPLC purity, and links to the certificate for the batch you received.

3.question: How is it delivered?
3.answer: We ship across Finland by Posti and other carriers. Delivery options and prices appear at checkout, and orders over €150 ship free.

4.question: Can I use these on humans or animals?
4.answer: No. These materials are sold for research use only. We cannot advise on, or support, human or veterinary administration.
